contracts.actual_behavior: While wearing these boots, Post living tick calls native helper. With boostTime<=15, water/bubble, airborne, fluidHeight(WATER)<.4F, rising Y and not player-flight: set boostTime35; add rotated forward Z=.5F+rng*1.2F to existing X/Z, write Y=.3D+rng*.3F, and align yaw to head yaw. During positive boost, airborne outside water/bubble damp descending Y by .75 and set FALL_FLYING pose, then decrement and store boostTime. This is a pose/motion control, not an Elytra damage/ownership replacement. Counter is native Citadel entity data and server sends its original data snapshot to all clients.

binary_parameters.water_surface_gate: boost<=15, fluidHeight<.4F, airborne, rising, not native flying

contracts.actual_behavior: Wearing the chestplate ticks this native helper. Water/bubble adds Y=-.015F even before roll admission. At counter0, sprint/not-shift/not-flight/not-passenger and canRollAgain admits30 ticks; clear forced SWIMMING pose at counter0. Positive counter forces player SWIMMING pose, and server each tick requests mobAttack(roller) damage2+rng*1 from nearby LivingEntity in bbox.inflate(1), excluding self and either-direction alliances; hurt results ignored. FallDistance>3 is reduced by.5. Refresh dimensions; airborne X/Z damping.9; facing drive .05F in water or .15F otherwise; first roll Y=.27 otherwise retainedY, or water/shift Y=-.1F. Counter decrements if>1 or not sprinting: counter1 persists while sprinting. Flight/shift cancellation still requires canRollAgain. Native UUID maps and roll-start timestamp are shared static storage; cooldown admits age>=20 or abs(age)>100. No separate projectile, damage source, knockback callback or per-victim timer is invented.
contracts.source_actor: Original chestplate wearer; mobAttack causing actor=roller

contracts.actual_behavior: Native lassoTo writes target-side Citadel data: real lassoer UUID/ID and Removed=false, or random UUID/-1/Removed=true for release; sets SentPacket=true and server broadcasts full tag. Lookup prefers nonnegative entity ID, then server UUID or client player UUID; Removed gates all lookup. Tick server condition uses contains(SentPacket) OR Removed, so an existing false key still triggers repeated snapshot sync. For a resolved owner, Mob navigates to owner at speed1 only when distance>3, otherwise stops. At distance>10, add each normalized axis squared times.4 with its original sign; player Y addition is forced0. No damage, ownership transfer or generic knockback. Entity interaction releases and cancels SUCCESS; death drop release remains native. Item admission/delivery is a later item-family boundary.
contracts.source_actor: Original lassoer linked by native target-side ID/UUID
